---
name: Feature request
about: A directive, function, option or SDK helper you would like
labels: enhancement
---

## The problem

What you are trying to do and where sigmx gets in the way.

## The proposal

The markup or API you would like to write. If it maps onto something in htmx, Alpine.js or Datastar, name it; the documented behaviour is what we match, never the code.

## Alternatives

What you can do today (a plugin of your own, a `data-init`, a server-side change) and why it falls short.

## Cost

Whether this belongs in the core, an existing plugin, a new plugin, or an SDK. Bundle size is recorded per plugin, so a rough idea of the bytes it would add helps.
